summary: Diffuse bilateral perihilar/basal haziness with indistinct vasculature on PRIOR appears improved on CURRENT, with sharper vascular markings and less confluent opacity.

findings.rationale: Bilateral perihilar/lower zone haziness and vascular indistinctness on PRIOR is less pronounced on CURRENT with clearer lung markings; residual mild haziness remains, and rotation/positioning differences limit certainty.
